question: Which vacant LS shell can you occupy this quarter?
line: Tour product with power, MEP, and adjacency — not the vacancy rate. 150 Industrial is the proof: 230,961 SF, former Novartis, robotics user, six high-credit groups in process. Peninsula office is 24.9% vacant. Mission Bay / China Basin office is 17.0% vacant; the LS block is still 51.9%.

question: Can this vacant science building become the AI tour?
line: Conversion only works if transformer capacity and cooling are real. AI office wants 3–5× standard office power and 2× CFM. Advanced R&D wants 2–3× power per SF plus clean-room HVAC. A CGT/GLP-1 shell that already has that MEP is the bid. Commodity office is residual.

question: Whose clock is the takeout on?
line: Underwrite delivery timing. Bay Area still takes 80% of U.S. AI VC since 2020, and 57% of local tech listings are AI. That is not a bid for every empty lab. Mission Bay LS at 51.9% vacant is a different credit than 16-year UCSF paper or a robotics full-building at 150 Industrial.
